# Catalyst: The Awakening

> A Lagos noir comic universe rooted in Yoruba mythology. Four free issues follow
> Adebayo "Bayo" Adeyemi, a 19-year-old from Mushin who awakens as the Catalyst —
> a vessel carrying the Aṣẹ of every Orisha at once — as the spirit world (the Ọ̀run)
> bleeds into Neo-Lagos and the Pale Council moves against the city.

Site: https://catalyst-awakening.netlify.app/

## Reading the story

- Issues 1–4 are free. Each has its own page, and all four are also
  readable as tabs within the home page:
  - Issue #01 — Awaken, O City: /read/issue-1
  - Issue #02 — Ṣàngó's Daughter: /read/issue-2
  - Issue #03 — Iron in the Blood: /read/issue-3
  - Issue #04 — The Price of Aṣẹ (Arc I finale): /read/issue-4
- Individual story pages are addressable two ways: /read/issue-{issue}#p{page}
  on an issue's own page, and /#read-i{issue}-p{page} on the home page.
  Either form redirects to the other if given to the wrong page.
- RSS: /feed.xml · Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Key characters

- Bayo Adeyemi — The Catalyst; multi-Orisha vessel, classification ÌMỌ̀LẸ̀-ÀÁRỌ̀
- Amara Okafor — Thunderstrike; Ṣàngó conduit through the talking drum
- Ikenna Chukwuemeka — The Iron Wolf; Ògún vessel, iron-skinned Mushin mechanic
- Zara — The Mirror; shadow operative
- The Oracle (Chief Adesanya) — 144-year-old seer and handler
- The Architect & the Pale Council — Geneva-based harvesters of Orisha power

## Community

Joining the newsletter enrolls readers in the Covenant of the Awakened: a
permanent numbered membership with a deterministic in-universe name (only an
email hash is stored server-side; the public honour roll shows in-universe
names only).

## Attribution

Original fiction by the CatalystVerse team, Lagos. Do not reproduce full issue
text; quoting short excerpts with a link to the reader page is welcome.
